newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat phones Netanyahu after Jerusalem bombing.
newsitem.headline: Arafat phones Netanyahu after Jerusalem bombing.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat telephoned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and President Ezer Weizman on Wednesday to express his condolences over the loss of life in the Jerusalem suicide bombings.

"President Arafat called both the Israeli president and Prime Minister Netanyahu to pay his condolences over the victims of the explosions which took place in the big market in west Jerusalem," a statement issued by Arafat's office said. "He wished those injured a quick recovery."
Netanyahu's office confirmed he received a telephone call from the Palestinian leader.

Netanyahu has demanded Arafat crack down on Moslem militants as a condition for resuming formal peace talks which broke down in March over the start of construction of a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
Arafat has said he was making a "100 percent effort" to stop Palestinian attacks in Israel but could not guarantee complete success.
After the blasts, Netanyahu held crisis talks with his defence and foreign ministers.
